mapper.select:
SELECT task_id, activity_name, group_type, task_name, task_date, service_time, location, quota_count, enrolled_count, status, description, dance_class_name, created_at FROM volunteer_task
(dance_class_name = #{danceClassName} OR dance_class_name = '全校/公共' OR dance_class_name = '全校全部' OR dance_class_name IS NULL OR dance_class_name = '')
ORDER BY task_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO volunteer_task(task_id, task_name, activity_name, group_type, task_date, service_time, location, quota_count, enrolled_count, status, description, dance_class_name) VALUES(#{taskId}, #{taskName}, #{activityName}, #{groupType}, #{taskDate}, #{serviceTime}, #{location}, #{quotaCount}, 0, 'RECRUITING', #{description}, #{danceClassName})
mapper.update: UPDATE volunteer_task SET status = 'FULL' WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND enrolled_count >= quota_count
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO volunteer_enrollment(enrollment_id, task_id, user_id, user_name, status) VALUES(#{enrollmentId}, #{taskId}, #{userId}, #{userName}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT enrollment_id, task_id, user_id, user_name, status, created_at FROM volunteer_enrollment WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
